name: California Science Center
description: A science museum in Exposition Park, Los Angeles. Space Shuttle Endeavour's permanent home, the Samuel Oschin Air and Space Center, opens there on 13 November 2026.

items.apollo-csm-block-ii: Command module CM-111, flown on the Apollo–Soyuz Test Project (1975)
items.endeavour: Space Shuttle Endeavour, standing upright in launch position with a real external tank and two solid rocket boosters
items.space-shuttle-orbiter: Space Shuttle Endeavour, standing upright in launch position with a real external tank and two solid rocket boosters
items.cargo-dragon-v1: A Dragon cargo capsule flown to the ISS on CRS-6, CRS-13 and CRS-18
